decisions.reason: The IMU module is a core sensing building block whose design and firmware investment and its fit with the newer-connector platform justify continued commitment.
Its dedicated product page and its role in the announced energy-management direction make it a visible commitment, so any slow uptake is read as a temporary ramp-up.
The kit only bundles existing modules and is peripheral to the firm's direction, but it costs little to keep and still serves industrial monitoring customers, so management keeps it.
Launched only in 2024 within the modular system, it is too early to judge, and the firmware and design investment argues for persisting.
The wallbox remote access service is central to the announced expansion of charging and energy management, so management is strongly committed to it.
